en.title: Slovenia or Austria? Where the snow is better on 17 November
en.description: Slovenia or Austria? Where the snow is better on 17 November. Snow cover, new snow, resorts and the days ahead in Slovenia on 17 November.
en.lede: 6 % of the mapped high ground is white in Slovenia, against 30 % in Austria. The deepest resort in Slovenia has 1 cm; in Austria it is Kühtai with 54 cm.

p: For a trip near the border this decides the direction: the snow is not where the map of borders would suggest, it is where the last storm went.
The white area in Slovenia stands at about 430 km² today, 700 km² lost since yesterday. That is 6 % of the high ground we map in Slovenia.

For comparison, the neighbours on the same day: Austria: 30 % white, deepest Kühtai with 54 cm, up to 47 cm in the week ahead; Italy: 13 % white, deepest La Thuile ski with 50 cm, up to 58 cm in the week ahead.
At the top of the list, Vogel reports 23 cm.
Then come Velika planina (21 cm), Golte (11 cm), Rogla (11 cm) and Sella Nevea (9 cm).
At Vogel: 2 cm of fresh snow over three days, 2 cm more expected by Friday 20 November.
Velika planina had no fresh snow in the last three days; 1 cm could fall by Friday 20 November.
13 of the 27 resorts we follow in Slovenia have snow on their upper slopes.
The rest of the shortlist: Golte: 11 cm on top, 0 cm in three days, 1 cm expected; Rogla: 11 cm on top, 0 cm in three days, 0 cm expected; Sella Nevea: 9 cm on top, 4 cm in three days, 9 cm expected.
Over the next three days up to 7 cm is expected, and up to 7 cm over the week.
The snowiest day looks like Thursday 19 November, with up to 6 cm in the snowiest spots.
Further out, days 8 to 14 show up to 22 cm on the snowiest slopes.

Snow depth on the ground, height by height: 500-1,000 m: on average under 1 cm (2 % of the ground white); 1,000-1,500 m: on average under 1 cm (9 % of the ground white); 1,500-2,000 m: on average 1 cm (28 % of the ground white); 2,000-2,500 m: on average 4 cm (73 % of the ground white).
Last week's 150 km² has grown by 280 km². The snow line sits near 2,000 m.
The last three days were dry or nearly so, with no more than 2 cm anywhere.

Here is how the deepest resorts compare with their usual 17 November: Vogel: 1 cm at about 1,152 m, against 1 cm in a normal year; Velika planina: 1 cm at about 1,536 m, against 0 cm in a normal year; Golte: 1 cm at about 1,424 m, against 0 cm in a normal year; Rogla: 2 cm at about 1,288 m, against 0 cm in a normal year.
3 of these 4 resorts are above their usual depth for the date.
These depths are for one height on each mountain, below the top, so they read lower than the upper-slope numbers further down.
In past winters the best snow at Vogel usually came mid-January / early February.

sections.h: Planning a day on the snow
p: Between 1,500 m and 2,500 m the cover is patchy, about 28 % white: expect grass and stones between the snow.
Below 1,500 m the slopes are still almost bare.

sections.h: What it means on the slopes
p: Mild weather is eating into the cover: expect firm snow in the morning and slush in the afternoon.

advice: Morning snow is firm after a clear night: wait for the sun on south faces.
Check the resort's own lift status before you travel.
Early-season snow is thin over rocks: ski the groomed runs first.

sl.title: Snežne razmere v Sloveniji, 17. novembra 2026: smučišča, novi sneg in naslednji dnevi
sl.description: Sneg v Sloveniji 17. novembra: snežna odeja, novi sneg, višina po nadmorski višini, naslednji dnevi in najboljša smučišča.
sl.lede: Snežna odeja v Sloveniji obsega približno 430 km² (torek, 17. novembra). To je 700 km² manj kot včeraj. To je 6 % gorskega območja v Sloveniji, ki ga spremljamo.

p: V primerjavi z 150 km² pred sedmimi dnevi je to 280 km² več. Snežna meja je okoli 2.000 m.

Višina snega je odvisna od nadmorske višine: 500–1.000 m: povprečno manj kot 1 cm (2 % pod snegom); 1.000–1.500 m: povprečno manj kot 1 cm (9 % pod snegom); 1.500–2.000 m: povprečno 1 cm (28 % pod snegom); 2.000–2.500 m: povprečno 4 cm (73 % pod snegom).
Zadnje tri dni skoraj ni snežilo: največ 2 cm.
Odjuga načenja odejo: zjutraj trd sneg, popoldne moker.
Največ snega na zgornjih progah: Vogel, 23 cm.
Sledijo: Velika planina (21 cm), Golte (11 cm), Rogla (11 cm) in Sella Nevea (9 cm).
Velika planina: tri dni brez novega snega; do datuma petek, 20. novembra lahko pade 1 cm.
V naslednjih treh dneh pričakujemo do 7 cm, v celem tednu do 7 cm.
Najbolj snežen dan: četrtek, 19. novembra, do 6 cm.

advice: Nad gozdno mejo je sneg lahko nanosil veter: previdno na grebenih.
